description: Emit a custom system event onto the gateway bus. Wraps `system-event`. Mostly used for tooling / debug — operators rarely call this directly.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON-serializable payload — forwarded to the gateway bus as-is. No schema enforced because consumers vary.

name: openclaw_system_event
